start.content: The candles are burning down, and He keeps speaking about washing feet and breaking bread like it is a farewell. I've been sitting on the stairs, trying to keep a written record of His words. Something is fracturing inside our circle tonight; I saw Judas spill the wine at the third cup.

choices.text: Did you see the bread on the table?

declaration.content: I am writing down His summary. He said this cup is the New Covenant in His blood. I want to make sure the declaration is perfect before the night is over.

judas.content: His eyes kept moving. Then Jesus gave him a piece of bread, dipped in the bitter herbs — I think I saw a fragment of it fall near the door. He said, "What you do, do quickly." Judas left immediately.

table.content: Jesus took the bread and broke it. I saw the crumbs scatter as He blessed it. Then the cup... we didn't understand. We were still thinking in terms of kingdoms and swords. He was speaking of something far greater — and far more terrible.

closing.content: The conversation is over. Go in peace.
